headline: The field learned to chain: Comet Drift's rivals now drive the drift ladder on purpose
lede: POLISH — COMET DRIFT GP (#1687, never-dry rung): the six CPU karts used to hold a drift until their look window emptied and bank whatever tier the corner happened to feed them. Now each rival has a plan — BLAZE and DUSTY chase gold across corner-chains, the midfield banks violet, the back markers blue early and safe — and the upgrade paid: field tier-points up 12-61% per course, golds finally lead with the front markers (1.5x the back markers, up from a flat 1.14x), and none of it bought with new spins.

notes.text: DRIFT_PLAN in sim.js: skill-scaled tier targets, a hold that survives short straight links while the tyres are down and the drift is steerable, bank-onto-exit release the moment the target is met, and an on-road safety gate that stops the pre-change habit of over-holding off the asphalt.

The certified autopilot line is structurally untouched — decide() keeps its own hold rule, pinned by a static gate — so every existing win-proof and attract replay rides the same certified line as before.

15 new cometcheck gates pin the economy on measured pack data (tier-point/violet floors, spin caps, the front-vs-back gold gradient, the plan's skill ladder) and the corner-luck mutant dies red against every floor. cometplay 29/29 in the browser; live now at /retrogames/comet-drift.
Residual opened honestly in the README: boost links still don't combo mid-boost (no linked chain), and tier targets are static per skill rather than read from the corner — the next lane's rungs.
